content_zh:
陪聊天：25元小时、3小时起15元小时；陪逛街：20元小时、3小时起10元小时；陪吃饭：5元小时、3小时起免费元小时……
叶晨在无数的平台发布过这样的广告，提供出租男友的业务。
现在社会，随着单身男女的增多，带着对象回家见父母，已经成为了单身男女迫在眉睫的事情。
叶晨因为他出众的外表，幽默的谈吐，良好的口碑，所以他的生意络绎不绝，完全就是个忖帅行凶的典范。
平时下了班，他都会按照上班摸鱼的时候，联系好客户，在私下见面，进行业务洽谈，无数的女生被他的气质所打动，直接签单，进入实操阶段。
叶晨也对这种生活很满意，因为双方在一开始就签订好了契约，哪怕是当时有一些比较亲昵的表现，他也会权当演戏，作为一个非科班出身的演员，在这方面他还是很专业的，甚至比一些专业演员做的都好，每次完成契约，他就好像是换了一个马甲，都能第一时间脱离角色，从不会让自己因戏生情。
他的这种做派，让很多馋他身体的女生感到很无奈，总有一种想得而得不到的郁闷，都在暗恨自己在生活中怎么就遇不到这样的男人。
不因为别的，只因为这个男人作为一个临时男友实在是太细心了，总能够让他的客户感觉到很满意，做到了现实中男友所做不到的一切。
陪你聊天的时候，和风细雨，声音带有磁性；陪你逛街的时候，总会站在你的外撇，保护好你的安全，没有一丝的不耐烦，而且还会时不时的提供比较专业的意见；陪你吃饭的时候，也会很绅士的为你做好一切……
叶晨本以为这个兼职他可以做到很久，然而命运却和他开了个不大不小的玩笑。
这一天，叶晨正在陪客户见家长，一顿饭吃的是宾主尽欢，所有人都很满意，他和自己的客户将家长刚送出门外，上了出租车，正要结束这一次的兼职，突然不知道从哪里从哪里钻出了一个拎着棒球棍的男子，照着叶晨的后脑勺就是一下子，只听“乓”
的一声，叶晨好像是面条一样的栽倒在地，耳边还传来自己客户的尖叫，还有袭击他的男子骂骂咧咧的声音：
“昨天还和我妹妹刚见得我父母，今天就换人了，当海王当到我妹妹头上来了，我看你特么是活腻歪了，我特么干死你！”
意识模糊的叶晨听到这句话的时候，只想大骂一声“卧槽，老子也太背了吧！”
可惜事与愿违，此时的他已经逐渐的失去了意识，只觉得眼前一黑，然后就什么都不知道了……
当叶晨睁开眼的时候，发现自己正躺在一间病房里，病床边上还坐着一个年轻的女人，看到叶晨睁开眼了，那个女人还开口问道：
“叶晨，你醒了，我刚刚问过医生了，医生说你是因为贫血晕倒的，吓了我一跳，刚开始我还以为你这货要碰瓷儿呢，平时姐可没少疼你，按说不应该啊，送到医院才知道你这是贫血，你在这儿等着，我去叫医生过来。”
说完，那个女人站起了身，朝着病房外走去，留下了一脸懵哔的叶晨。
叶晨是真懵了，因为他已经看出不同来了，那个女人的装束，和他的装束都充满了六七十年代的韵味，换到现在你要是这么穿衣服，别人指定是拿你当山炮的。
“侦测到宿主有强烈的求生欲，特绑定影视世界冒险系统，系统绑定中10%……30……70……绑定成功。

姓名：叶晨
种族：人类
身体属性：体质5
力量5
智力6
敏捷5
现有自由属性点2
技能：演技入门LV1（对于演技属于野路子，初窥门径）
套娃技能LV4（天赋异禀）
海王技能LV4（你是个标准的LSP）”
本来还处在懵哔状态的叶晨，突然在脑海里听到一阵机械音，还挺兴奋，因为他也是个骨灰级的老书虫了，知道这是自己被系统绑定的前兆，妥妥的人生赢家有莫有？结果在看到系统的技能栏之后，整个人都不好了，你特么对我是抱有了多大的恶意？我哪里就LSP了？我是万花丛中过，片叶不沾身好不好？是她们馋我的身体和我有毛关系？
还没等叶晨吐出一口老槽，一阵投影在叶晨的面前闪过：
“系统检测到宿主在现实世界即将面临脑死亡的情况，鉴于宿主有强烈的求生意志，特此绑定宿主，宿主可通过完成系统在影视世界，发布的任务，换取现实世界的寿命，并可得到丰厚的技能奖励，是否接受：（YN）”
这还有什么犹豫的？能够活着谁愿意入土为安？叶晨唯恐画面消失，一切成空，第一时间选择了接受，接着叶晨就看到眼前的画面一转，投影界面上出现了新的文字：
“系统监测到《情满四合院》编号的观众的吐槽：这部剧里男的女的都没一个好东西，真是应了那副对联，琴瑟琵琶，八大王一般模样，魑魅魍魉，四小鬼各自肚肠。
就这种人最后还能得以善终，这世界到底是怎么了？
系统任务：给四合院里的这些禽兽一个终身难忘的教训，发挥你的特长，让这些禽兽不得善终！
任务难度：简单
任务奖励：三年寿命，系统技能随机
失败惩罚：解绑并以初始状态返回原时空

是否接受：YN？”
叶晨看到这里整个人都不好了，你特么都要给我抹杀了，我还有说不的权利吗？遇到这种动不动就用抹杀来威胁的系统，哪怕是完成任务，可以有寿命加成，叶晨的心里也还是一片阴霾，但是没办法，现在自己已经到了这个地步了，自己也没有别的选择了，只能硬着头皮上了。
叶晨点击了接受选项，然后一股数据流顷刻之间塞到了叶晨的脑子里，系统把《情满四合院》的所有内容瞬间放进了叶晨的记忆空间里，方便叶晨随时调阅。

content_en:
Chat companion: 25 yuan per hour, 15 yuan per hour starting from 3 hours; shopping companion: 20 yuan per hour, 10 yuan per hour starting from 3 hours; dining companion: 5 yuan per hour, free 1 yuan per hour starting from 3 hours...
Ye Chen has published such advertisements on countless platforms, providing business for renting out boyfriends.
In today's society, as the number of single men and women increases, it has become an urgent matter for single men and women to take their partner home to meet their parents.
Because of his outstanding appearance, humorous conversation, and good reputation, Ye Chen has a steady stream of business and is a perfect example of a handsome man who commits crimes.
Normally after work, he would contact customers, meet in private, and conduct business negotiations as he did when he was at work. Countless girls were impressed by his temperament and signed orders directly, entering the practical stage.
Ye Chen is also very satisfied with this kind of life, because the two parties signed a contract from the beginning, and even if there were some relatively intimate performances at the time, he would still act. As an actor with a non-major background, he is still very professional in this regard, even better than some professional actors. Every time he completes the contract, he seems to have changed a vest, and he can get out of the role immediately, and never let himself get emotional due to drama.
His behavior makes many girls who are greedy for his body feel helpless. They always feel depressed that they can't get what they want, and they all secretly hate themselves for not meeting such a man in their lives.
It's not because of anything else, just because this man is so attentive as a temporary boyfriend, he can always make his clients feel very satisfied, and he can do everything that real boyfriends can't do.
When chatting with you, his voice is gentle and magnetic; when he goes shopping with you, he always stands by your side and protects your safety without a trace of impatience, and he will also provide more professional advice from time to time; when he eats with you, he will also do everything for you in a gentlemanly manner...
Ye Chen thought he could do this part-time job for a long time, but fate played a big joke on him.
On this day, Ye Chen was accompanying a client to meet their parents. They had a meal that was a feast for both the host and the guest. Everyone was very satisfied. He and his client had just sent the parents out of the house and got into a taxi. They were about to end their part-time job. Suddenly, a man carrying a baseball bat appeared out of nowhere and pointed at the back of Ye Chen's head. All he heard was "Pong!"
With a loud sound, Ye Chen fell to the ground like a noodle. He heard the screams of his clients and the cursing voice of the man who attacked him:
"Yesterday, my sister and I just met my parents, but today they changed their roles. Now it's my sister who is the King of Neptune. I think you're really tired of living. I'm going to fuck you to death!"
When Ye Chen, who was unconscious, heard this sentence, he just wanted to yell, "Damn it, I'm so memorized!"
Unfortunately, things went against his wishes. At this time, he had gradually lost consciousness. He only felt that his vision went dark, and then he didn't know anything anymore...
When Ye Chen opened his eyes, he found that he was lying in a ward. There was a young woman sitting beside the hospital bed. Seeing Ye Chen open his eyes, the woman asked:
"Ye Chen, you're awake. I just asked the doctor. The doctor said that you fainted because of anemia. I was shocked. At first, I thought you were going to get into trouble. I usually hurt you a lot, and I shouldn't. It wasn't until I got you to the hospital that I found out that you were anemic. You wait here, and I'll call the doctor."
After saying that, the woman stood up and walked out of the ward, leaving behind a confused Ye Chen.
Ye Chen was really confused, because he had already noticed the difference. The woman's attire and his attire were both full of the charm of the 1960s and 1970s. If you dress like this now, others will definitely use you as a mountain gun.
"It is detected that the host has a strong desire to survive, and the host is specially boundFixed the film and television world adventure system, 10%...30...70...of the system binding was successful.
Name: Ye Chen
Race: Human
Physical attributes: Constitution 5
Power 5
Intelligence 6
Agility 5
Existing free attribute points 2
Skills: Acting Beginner LV1 (acting is a wild way to get a first glimpse of the path)
Matryoshka Doll Skill LV4 (Extraordinary Talent)
Neptune Skill LV4 (You are a standard LSP)"
Ye Chen, who was still in a state of confusion, suddenly heard a mechanical sound in his mind. He was quite excited because he was also a hardcore old bookworm. He knew that this was a sign that he was bound to the system. Is there any real winner in life? As a result, after seeing the system's skill bar, I felt bad. How much malice do you have towards me? Where is my LSP? I am walking among thousands of flowers, and not a single leaf touches me, okay? Is it because they are greedy for my body?
Before Ye Chen could spit out his old words, a projection flashed in front of Ye Chen:
"The system has detected that the host is about to face brain death in the real world. In view of the host's strong will to survive, the host is hereby bound. The host can complete the tasks released by the system in the film and television world in exchange for life in the real world and receive generous skill rewards. Do you accept: (YN)"
Why is there any hesitation? Who wants to be buried alive if they can survive? Ye Chen was afraid that the picture would disappear and everything would become empty, so he immediately chose to accept it. Then Ye Chen saw the picture in front of him change, and new text appeared on the projection interface:
"The system has monitored the complaints from viewers of "The Courtyard of Love": None of the men or women in this drama are good, and they really fit in with the couplet, playing the harp, playing the pipa, looking like the Eight Kings, monsters, monsters, and four little devils with their own hearts and minds.
If a person like this can finally die a good death, what is going on in this world?
System mission: Give these beasts in the courtyard an unforgettable lesson. Use your strengths to prevent these beasts from ending up well!
Mission Difficulty: Easy
Mission reward: three years lifespan, random system skills
Failure penalty: unbind and return to the original time and space in the initial state
Accept: YN? "
Ye Chen saw that everyone here was in bad shape. You are going to kill me. Do I still have the right to say no? Encountering this kind of system that threatens with obliteration at every turn, even if he completes the task and gets a lifespan bonus, Ye Chen's heart is still in a haze, but there is no way. Now that he has reached this point, he has no other choice but to bite the bullet.
Ye Chen clicked the accept option, and then a stream of data was instantly poured into Ye Chen's mind. The system instantly put all the contents of "Love in the Courtyard" into Ye Chen's memory space, making it easy for Ye Chen to access it at any time.
